description: Wallet balance on Ethereum, Base, Arc or BNB Chain: native coin (ETH, BNB, or USDC on Arc), the chain USDC or up to 20 ERC20 tokens you list, nonce, and whether the address is a contract. $0.002 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

tokens.description: optional: up to 20 ERC20 addresses, comma-separated

name: evm_wallet_balance
